title: BrainRunRecord
description:
One line of a repo's `.brain/runs.jsonl` (spec-agent-memory-system.md v1.0 section 2.4, D143): append-only, one per dispatched run or interactive session. Read typed by `agent-runner` (`GET /brain/{repo}/runs`) and `dashboard`. Not to be confused with `runner.run-record`, the dispatch record agent-runner keeps for the run itself.

Two line shapes, told apart by `kind`: a RUN line (`dispatched` | `interactive`) and the follow-up line a retried deferred job appends (`brain-job`, with `job` and `result`). A deferred job never rewrites the original line.

`model`, `effort` and `runtime` are what actually ran, taken from the run record; when the run did not report one it is ABSENT (never guessed, never a placeholder). `at` is a date-time; `task` is at most 200 characters.

runId.description: The agent-runner run id (dispatched) or the interactive session id.

at.description: ISO end time of the run or session.

model.description: The model that ACTUALLY ran, taken from the run record, never hard-coded. Absent when the run did not report one.

effort.description: The effort that actually ran. A free string (what ran, not what the brain accepts). Absent when not reported.

runtime.description: The runtime profile that ran it (`claude`, `claude-api`, `codex`, ...). Absent when not reported.

task.description: One line: what the run was for.

triage.description: The triage verdict. `deferred` marks a job waiting on a usage limit or the daily ceiling: the retry rewrites nothing and appends a `kind: brain-job` line instead.

harvested.description: Whether harvest has run for this run.

candidates.description: Candidates harvest wrote to `.brain/inbox/` for this run.

brainTokens.description: Tokens the brain spent on this run (triage + harvest), for the budget metric.

runId.description: The run the retried job belongs to.

result.description: What the retried toolkit command printed.
